key_points: Visa, Mastercard, and Ant International announced a cross-network Know Your Agent (KYA) interoperability framework for agentic finance.
Europe reports live agent payment rails across 30+ banks, while the US remains undecided on liability, highlighting Mastercard's potential early‑mover advantage in regulated markets.
Mastercard’s programmable cards are gaining traction via Alchemy, giving AI agents spending controls and widening distribution.
A $167.5 million Visa‑Mastercard ATM‑fee settlement may result in modest payouts to users, representing a small cost overhang.
Visa’s stablecoin settlement volume grew 15x YoY, underscoring competitive pressure in emerging payment rails.
